body.x: Dust, steam and smoke blind the cameras and lasers that a mobile robot steers by, and those are exactly the conditions where the worksite is most dangerous. Finding a way to see through them keeps the robots working where people shouldn't.

MilliTrack CO., LTD received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Construction & Industrial Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for MilliTrack AMR+, an RF localization add-on for autonomous mobile robots.

In the global steel industry, 36 percent of total accidents occur in low-visibility conditions. MilliTrack AMR+ is an RF localization add-on that extends autonomous mobile robots' operational horizon into low-visibility industries filled with dust, steam and smoke, where optical sensors such as LiDAR and cameras fail. It offers precise localization under the most visually challenging conditions and collision avoidance that meets IEC TS 61496-5 safety standards.

An AMR+ Tag installs on demand wherever optical sensors fail, simply by attaching it without cabling, and lasts 20 years on a single battery. An AMR+ Tracker mounts on any AMR for 3 cm localization accuracy, the highest among RF localization products on the market.
AMR+ integrates with an AMR's native localization stack to transition to AMR+ localization when necessary, keeping the current workflow to minimize adoption cost.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
